name: Bioteque Corporation
summary: Bioteque Corporation manufactures and sells medical devices in Asia, South America, North America, and internationally. The company offers angiography catheter, balloon dilation catheter, guiding sheath, guide steel wire, y-type connector, multi-pipe joint, connecting pipe, y-type connector assembly, peripheral vascular guiding catheter, coronary balloon dilation catheter, central venous catheter, microcatheter assembly, injection tube sleeve assembly for radiographic catheters, micro-puncture guide assembly, closed suction catheter, oxygen masks and tubing, anesthesia mask, sprayer and spray mask, endotracheal tube, and tracheostomy tube.
